fuente.titulo: Pope Leo prays for Gaza victims: ‘How long, O Lord?’ - Vatican News

bajada: Message to Fr. Gabriel Romanelli, parish priest of Holy Family Church in Gaza · 2026
caption:
“Since learning the painful news of the deaths of Maysa and Mary, I have been praying to God for them, for their families and for the entire community of Gaza. How long, O Lord?”

— Pope Leo XIV, Message to Fr. Gabriel Romanelli, parish priest of Holy Family Church in Gaza (2026)

Via Vatican News, 5 October 2026

#PopeLeoXIV #Vatican #CatholicChurch
